title: square and hexagonal kellys for direct rotary drilling
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11180) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for square and hexagonal kellys for direct rotary drilling.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Mechanical testing of metals - Tensile Testing
Method for Charpy Impact Test (U-notch) for Metals
square and hexagonal kellys for direct rotary drilling (IS 11180(PART 1))

clause_3_terminology: square and hexagonal kellys for direct rotary drilling

mechanical_properties: Minimum elongation on test specimen with L^ = 5
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
